gloss: heaviness in the stomach; indigestion; something to lean on

definitions.gloss: heaviness in the stomach; indigestion; feeling of fullness
definitions.explanation: An uncomfortable heavy feeling in the stomach after eating, as if food is sitting undigested. A common everyday complaint.

definitions.gloss: backrest; something to lean on; support
definitions.explanation: Something to lean one's back or body against for support, such as the back of a chair or a wall.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べすぎて{胃|い}もたれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have a heavy stomach from eating too much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{脂|あぶら}っこい→脂っこい：14728_aburakkoi⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{胃|い}もたれ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Greasy food tends to cause a heavy stomach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{胃|い}もたれしやすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。

examples.english: I used the wall as a backrest and read a book.

notes:
Derived from the verb もたれる (to lean against, to feel heavy in the stomach). Sense 1 most commonly appears in the compound {胃|い}もたれ (stomach heaviness), which is one of the most frequent health complaints in everyday Japanese. Sense 2 is more commonly expressed as {背|せ}もたれ (backrest).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃|い}もたれ: stomach heaviness, indigestion
- {胃|い}もたれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a heavy stomach
- {背|せ}もたれ: backrest of a chair
- もたれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: severe indigestion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{胸焼|むねや}け→胸焼け：22809_muneyake⟧: heartburn — a burning sensation in the chest from acid reflux
- もたれる: to lean against; to feel heavy — the verb form from which this noun derives
- {消化不良|しょうかふりょう}: indigestion — a more formal medical term for poor digestion
